purpose: Prove the server-side visibility seam used by future Relationship standing stock projection without claiming client refresh, reward-to-assort physical behavior, Economy approval, or runtime materialization.

provenServerPath.sessionScope: DynamicRouter RouteAction receives the requesting sessionId and passes it to RelationshipStandingAssortCoordinator
provenServerPath.pinnedSptProfileResolution: ProfileHelper.GetPmcProfile(sessionId) returns GetFullProfile(sessionId).CharacterData.PmcData from SaveServer-backed profile state
provenServerPath.standingRead: Resolver reads pmcProfile.TradersInfo[AdmiralTraderId].Standing and accepts only finite values
provenServerPath.fallback: Missing profile/trader/standing fails closed to LL1 finite-stock baseline

nonClaims: This proof does not assert that a completed quest reward is reflected by the client without reopening or refreshing trader UI.
This proof does not assert a physical reward -> standing -> projected stock transition on SPT runtime.
This proof does not approve the proposed LL2-LL4 marker stock quantities or personal buy limits.
This proof does not alter frozen 0.1.0 quests, rewards, assort, loyalty or standing values.

futurePhysicalCheckpoint.expectedPass: After a standing-changing lifecycle event, a subsequent Admiral assort request for the same session resolves the updated PMC TradersInfo standing and projects exactly the corresponding finite marker tier when materialization is intentionally enabled in a later approved slice.
diagnosticFailBoundaries: Profile TradersInfo standing itself remains unchanged after the lifecycle event: reward/profile mutation boundary.
Profile standing changes but resolver sees stale/different standing for the same session: server profile-resolution boundary.
Resolver sees updated standing but returned assort retains LL1 values: Admiral projection/router boundary.
Server returns projected values but trader UI remains stale until refresh/reopen: client refresh/cache boundary.
